**Replying to role assignment issues**

When an admin reassigns a role through the UI, it should take effect immediately, though they might need to sign out or refresh the page. If using SSO like Okta, group membership may need an update from there. I recommend reassigning viewer roles instead of clearing all roles and setting at least one backup admin. It’s useful for admins to enable role-change notifications and perform periodic audits to avoid accidental removals. Clear cache or sign back in if issues persist!
**Reviewing organization role settings**

I'm happy to help with your organization role settings! When an admin reassigns the "Analytics Viewer" role, the change should be immediate, and refreshing the page usually restores access. If you're using Okta or SCIM, the IdP group sync may take some time, so it’s good to verify that roles aren’t being overridden. If needed, I can offer to set up alerts or open a ticket to review your organization role configuration. Just let me know!
**Making role assignment recommendations**

I recommend that admins assign analytics roles to a dedicated "Analytics Viewers" group instead of individual users. It’s also wise to ensure there's at least one backup admin with the right permissions and to avoid bulk role-clearing without proper review.
